method.csv: streamed gzip CSV; counts are disjoint only where explicitly named
method.native_counter_rule: backend-native counter deltas are descriptive and never cross-backend ratios
method.readback_attribution: swapped_read_io and swapped_read_cached are retrieval events; disk requests are independent aggregate counters and cannot be assigned to individual pages
method.snapshot_memcomp: snapshot_classification=memcomp means a memcomp PTE in the snapshot; it may have been written back and retrieved from disk or cache

rows.writeback_accounting_note: memcomp payload conversions; not physical bytes or guest pages
